module.name: Monochrome
module.author: Viscousity
module.description: Ultra-fast parallel dual-engine Lossless & Hi-Res FLAC provider (Qobuz Hi-Res up to 24-bit/192 kHz + Monochrome Native FLAC) with speculative stream pre-warming, authentic per-track FLAC metadata, and seamless zero-error YouTube Music failover.

qualityOptions.label: Studio Master Hi-Res · up to 24-bit / 192 kHz FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Streams true 24-bit Studio Master FLAC when available, falling back smoothly to 16-bit CD Lossless.

qualityOptions.label: Lossless CD · 16-bit / 44.1 kHz FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Bit-perfect 16-bit CD FLAC with lighter mobile bandwidth consumption.

sourcePriority.label: Source & Speed Mode
sourcePriority.description: Controls how Qobuz (Arcod) and Monochrome race during search and failover

options.label: Instant Dual-Race (Fastest + Best FLAC Quality)
options.description: Races Qobuz Hi-Res & Monochrome simultaneously with speculative stream ticket pre-warming

options.label: Qobuz Hi-Res Primary (Up to 24-bit / 192 kHz)
options.description: Prioritizes Qobuz Hi-Res catalog with Monochrome automatic failover

options.label: Monochrome Primary (Qobuz Failover)
options.description: Prioritizes tracks.monochrome.st with Qobuz Hi-Res automatic failover

options.label: Monochrome Only (tracks.monochrome.st)
options.description: Use only Monochrome native FLAC backend

targetResolution.label: Resolution Preference
targetResolution.description: Preferred lossless FLAC bit-depth and sample rate profile

options.label: Adaptive (Highest available 24-bit Hi-Res or 16-bit CD)
options.description: Automatically delivers the highest genuine lossless fidelity for each song

options.label: Standard CD Lossless (16-bit / 44.1 kHz)
options.description: Requests 16-bit CD FLAC (~25-40 MB per track)

options.label: Strict Studio Master (24-bit or >48 kHz only)
options.description: Accepts only verified 24-bit or >48 kHz masters; falls back otherwise

fastStartMode.label: Playback Start Mode
fastStartMode.description: Balance instant sub-second playback against full binary FLAC header pre-checks

options.label: Instant Start (Recommended)
options.description: Overlaps stream ticket/header checks during search; onPlaybackError handles rare CDN retries seamlessly

options.label: Strict Pre-Verify Header
options.description: Probes 64-byte fLaC header & exact file size on every stream URL before starting ExoPlayer

normalizeSoundtrackTitles.label: Normalize Soundtrack Suffixes
normalizeSoundtrackTitles.description: Allows strict matching of tracks like '(From "Movie")' while preserving Remix/Live/Radio Edit markers

customHifiApiUrl.label: Custom HiFi-API URL (Optional)
customHifiApiUrl.description: Optional base URL for a private binimum/hifi-api server (tested for full non-preview FLAC streams)
